_description: Cursor bundle agent-pack catalog. `core` is the default install — explore, planner, reviewer. Extended packs mirror the codex agent roster, grouped by domain, matching the skill-pack domains where sensible. Extended agents ship physically alongside core under .cursor/agents/ (there is no per-agent install-time filtering yet, unlike skills) — this catalog is the organizational/documentation grouping for future selection tooling.

core.description: Default install: fast read-only repo orientation (explore), architecture/implementation planning (planner), evidence-ranked post-implementation review (reviewer). Kept small per Cursor's own guidance against many vague-description agents degrading auto-routing quality.

development.description: Implementation and architecture roles layered on top of the core lifecycle: production coding, system design, research, and test authoring.

review.description: Behavioral active-verification and security-audit roles, distinct from the core reviewer's structural review.

product.description: Product/planning roles: solution brainstorming, ticket sizing, delivery-status tracking, interview-driven advisory, and one-shot advice-checkpoint supervision.

operations.description: Delivery-pipeline and knowledge-capture roles: shipping, git operations, failure journaling, living docs, and cost/pattern analysis.

media.description: UI/UX design roles: component design, design systems, wireframes, accessibility audits.

integrations.description: External-service integration roles: Jira issue/agile/admin/JSM operations and Confluence page/search/collaboration operations, each scoped to a single CLI-wrapper domain.
